steps.say: Plan your whole night with Favorites.
Tap the heart on a place to save it.
Save a few more places you like.
Tap the heart in the bottom menu to open Favorites.
Your stops are listed in driving order.
Tap Route these.
Here is your route, with every stop listed.
Tap the arrows to pick your maps app.
Apple Maps, Google Maps or Waze.
One tap, one route.
Open the map near you, and find places you like.
Tap Route these on the map.
Here are your stops, nine at a time.
Tap the arrows to choose your maps app.
Apple Maps, Google Maps or Waze.
Then tap Open, and your phone switches to that app.
A longer trip is split into more routes.

w08.closing: Free, on SoCal Lights dot app.

steps.say: Looking for holiday lights tonight?
Tap Find my location.
Pull up the list to see what is near you.
Tap This weekend to see what is on soon.
Or tap Free to see only free places.
Tap a place to open its details.
Then tap Directions to go.
Your phone switches to the maps app you choose.

w06.closing: Free, on SoCal Lights dot app.

steps.say: Is your home all lit up?
Tap Sign in, and use an emailed code.
Choose who is posting: a homeowner.
Add the name to show.
Pick the season for your lights.
Name your home, and say what makes it special.
Add the street, and the ZIP code.
Photos are optional.
Check everything, then tap Put it on the map.
And there it is, on the map.
Tap your home to open its details.
Anyone can find it, and tap Directions.
